03 — Tools that touch disk

Part II · Act · Difficulty: medium · 60 to 90 minutes · 8 graded cases

The agent gains write and bash. The tools themselves are short. The hard part is that both can produce unbounded output, and one can run forever.
How it worksoverview.md — untrusted arguments, unbounded output, unbounded time
What to buildproblem.md — the contract, the graded claims, the hints
